translation:
When it comes to games, it seems like Koizumi
prefers tabletop games.

I guess you're right. He even says himself
that he enjoys them despite being bad.

He enjoys them despite being bad… That's
strange since he's so smart, isn't it?
I wonder why he's not so good at them?

You're right… It is weird after all this time
playing them. Maybe he's just unlucky.
You seem to be very lucky, Suzumiya.
